profile_text.body:
Course Hero describes itself as a study platform offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep, 24/7 homework help, and tutors. The company says it is a Learneo, Inc. business, and its site carries a notice that it is not sponsored or endorsed by any college or university. It was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Redwood City.

The company's tracked AI product is QuillBot, listed under writing and editing with a note of paraphrasing. No lawsuits and no MCP servers are recorded for the company.
